content: Phawuloosa Hawaareti Mokki Ekkida
Tammanne oyddu layththafe guye qasseka Yerusalaame badis; he wode Barnabaasara days; Titoosakka tanara ekka badis.

Taas qonccida gishshas hee badis; Ayzaabeta giddon ta sabbakiza Mishiraachcho qaalaakka isttas yootadis; gido attiin ta kase mela woxxidaakko gaadanne qasseka sinththafe coo mela woxxontta mala hirgada waannatizaytas dumma erisadis.
Haray attoshin tanara diza Titoosi izi Girike as shin izi qaxxarettana mala wolqqaththibeettenna.

Hayssi ha yo7ozi dendiday issi issi wordo ammanizayti nuni Yesus Kirstoosan demmida geeshshateththaa yuuyi yuuyi paacci beyanaassinne nuna aylleteththan zaari gelththanaas loddara nuukko salli gelida gishshassa.
Heyta he asatas nuni issitokka haarettibeekko; hessika intte Mishiraachcho qaalaa tumateththan eqqi daana mala giidikko.
Waanna misatiza asati taas aykkoka misatettenna; Xoossi asa ayfeso be7idi maado ooththi erenna; heyti he asati ta kiittiza yo7otas taas aykkoka gujjibeettenna.
Gido attiin Phexroosi qaxxarettidaytas Mishiraachcho qaalaa sabbakanaas hadara ekkidayssa mala tanikka qaxxarettonttaytas Mishiraachcho qaalaa sabbakanaas hadara ekkidayssa istti erida.
Phexroosi Ayhudatas Hawaare gidi ooththana mala ooththida Xoossay tanikka Ayzaabetas Hawaare gida ooththana mala taas ooththides.

Waannati Yaaqoobey, Phexroosinne Yohannisikka taas imettida Xoossa imotaa akeekidi taassinne Barnabaasas ba ushachcha kushe immida; hessafe guye nuni Ayzaabetas istti qasse Ayhudatas qaala yootanaas qaalaa ero gi ekkida.
Istti nuus hadara giday manqotas qofa nu aggontta mala; ta amoykka hessa ooththanaassa.
Phawuloosi Phexroosa Qopheth
Phexroosi Anxokiya yida wode erettida bala ooththida gishshas ta iza qonccen qophadis.
Issi issi asati Yaaqoobe achchafe yaanaappe kase Phexroosi Ayzaabetara issife kath mizayssa aggidi asati yidaappe guye qaxxarettida asatas babbidi Ayzaabetappe shaaketti guye guye guus oykkides.
Barnabaasikka isttaththo qoodheppe qommon hanon ekettana gakkanaas hara Ayhuda baggafe ammanida asaykka izara issifettides.

Istta oosoy Mishiraachcho qaalaa tuman gidonttayssa ta erada kumeththa asaa achchan Phexroosa, «Ne Ayhuda as shin Ayzaabeta wogan attiin Ayhudata wogan dabeekka; histtiin Ayzaabeti Ayhudata woga kaallana mala aazas wolqqaththay?» gadis.
«Nuni nu yeleteththan Ayhudatappe attiin Ayzaabeta mala nagaranchcha gidokko.

Asi Yesus Kirstoosan ammanon xillana attiin woga naagon xillonttayssa nu eroos; hessa gishshas woga naagon gidontta Kirstoosa ammanon nu xillana mala nunikka qasse Yesus Kirstoosa ammanidos; woga naagon oonikka xillenna.
«Nu Kirstoosan xillana koykko nuni nagaranchchata gididayssi qoncci erettides; histtiin Kirstoosi nagaray dari dari baana mala koyzee? Koyenna.
Tani laallidayssa zaarada tarkka ta kushera keexxiko tanikka woga mooridaade gididayssa ammanettays.
Tani Xoossas daana mala wogaa baggara he wogaas hayqqadis.

Tani Kirstoosara kaqettadis; hayssafe guye tani taas diikke; gido attiin Kirstoosi ta giddon dees; ha7ikka ta ashon diza duussay tana dosidi bana ta gishshas aaththi immida Xoossa Naa bolla diza ammanon diza duussa.
Tani Xoossa kiyateth kawushshike; xilloteththi woga naagon beettiza miish gidikko Kirstoosi hada hayqqides guussakaa!»
